scope: DNB série générale, written exams in mathématiques and sciences (physique-chimie / SVT / technologie). Série professionnelle has distinct subjects (see S1) and is out of scope except where noted.

sessions.subject: mathematiques
sessions.duration: 2 h (Partie 1: 20 min, then Partie 2: 1 h 40, no break, two separate answer sheets; the Partie 1 sheet is collected after 20 min)
sessions.points: /20, coefficient 2 (written exams = 60 % of the final DNB mark, contrôle continu = 40 %)
sessions.examDate: Monday 28 June 2027, 10 h – 12 h (Paris time, métropole / La Réunion / Mayotte)
sessions.programmeBasis: Note de service MENE2623228N: 'programme de mathématiques de la classe de troisième s'il est en vigueur ou, à défaut, des programmes de cycle 4'. The new cycle 4 maths programme (arrêté 18-02-2026, BO n°10 du 5-03-2026) reaches 3e only at rentrée 2028, so for session 2027 the reference is in practice the current (2020-revised) cycle 4 programme. Partie 1 explicitly targets 'automatismes du cycle 4'. See limitations L3.

structure.description: Short-answer questions mobilising cycle-4 automatismes or a direct application of a property, formula or theorem. No justification required or assessed. Number of questions not fixed (8–9 in every 2026 paper and reference subject examined). Per IEA inspection (S8): questions scored 0.5 or 1 pt; formats = direct answer, vrai/faux, or QCM with exactly one correct answer out of 4; wrong/missing answer costs nothing. The candidate copies question number + answer on the sheet.
structure.calculator: Not allowed (except candidates whose aménagement d'examen authorises it, S8/S9).

structure.part: Partie 2 – Raisonnement et résolution de problèmes
structure.points: 14 (of which 2 points assess clarity/precision of reasoning and the four dimensions of maîtrise de la langue; i.e. ~12 points of exercises)
structure.description: Independent exercises; may use real-life contexts or other disciplines; any format EXCEPT QCM. All answers must be justified unless stated otherwise; attempts and unfinished approaches are credited. Number of exercises not fixed (4 exercises of 2–4.5 pts in the 2026 papers examined; reference subjects: 3 exercises of 4 pts). Draft paper allowed throughout.
structure.calculator: Allowed: calculatrice with active 'mode examen' or non-programmable 'type collège' without memory (circulaire 2015-178).

sessions.subject: sciences
sessions.duration: 1 h total = 2 × 30 min (indicative time split), one single answer sheet
sessions.points: /20, coefficient 2; 10 points per discipline; 2 of the 20 points (1 per discipline) assess the four dimensions of maîtrise de la langue
sessions.examDate: Monday 28 June 2027, 8 h – 9 h (Paris time), same morning as maths
sessions.programmeBasis: Programmes de la classe de troisième if in force, otherwise cycle 4 programmes, for each of PC / SVT / technologie (S1). No new PC/SVT/technologie cycle-4 programme was found in force for 2026-2027 (S13, supplementary) -> current cycle 4 programmes apply.

structure.description: Independent exercises; at least some require initiative (question ouverte, chercher/raisonner); exploit numerical and/or experimental data; analyse information with the discipline's reasoning, methods and models; written expression assessed (1 pt). Exact answers and clearly formulated relevant ideas fully credited; partial approaches credited.
structure.calculator: Not specified in the note de service. For session 2026 the cover page of sciences subjects stated that calculators (mode examen or type collège) are allowed (S9); assume the same unless the 2027 subject says otherwise.

structure.description: Same rules. The two disciplines are announced on Éduscol two months before the exam; choice valid for June and September sessions; may differ for centres étrangers.

sessions.subject: mathematiques
sessions.duration: 2 h (20 min + 1 h 40); tiers-temps: 27 min + 2 h 14
sessions.points: /20, coefficient 2 (first session with 60 % written exams / 40 % contrôle continu)

structure.description: First session with an automatismes part. Real papers: 8–9 questions; Métropole 30-06-2026 was presented as 'Automatismes – QCM' (9 questions); Amérique du Nord, Centres étrangers mixed direct answers and choices. Supported by an Éduscol indicative list of automatismes (Oct 2025), a livret, and 2 sujets zéro (série générale) + 2 (série professionnelle).

structure.part: Partie 2 – Raisonnement et résolution de problèmes
structure.points: 14 (12 for exercises 'comparable to previous sessions' + 2 for clarity/precision of reasoning and rédaction)
structure.description: Real 2026 papers (Métropole, Amérique du Nord, Asie, Centres étrangers): 4 exercises totalling 12 points.
structure.calculator: Allowed for all candidates (mode examen or type collège).

sessions.subject: sciences
sessions.points: /20, coefficient 2, 10 points per discipline (per secondary/academic sources; S10 itself not read)

structure.description: Per SNES report of a Nancy-Metz inspection letter (local, May 2026): shorter exercise, max 7 questions, at least one initiative question and one writing-quality question with minimum line count. Not confirmed as a national rule.
structure.calculator: Allowed (cover page instruction reported in S9).

sessions.subject: mathematiques
sessions.points: 100 points (DNB total 800 = 400 socle/contrôle continu + 400 épreuves: français 100, maths 100, HG-EMC 50, sciences 50, oral 100 — per S20 summary); maths subjects typically 5–7 exercises whose points sum to 100

structure.description: 5–7 independent exercises (e.g. Métropole 2019: 6 exercises 10–19 pts; 2021–2025: 5 exercises ~18–23 pts). From 2020 onward, one exercise per Métropole paper was usually a QCM (3 choices, no justification). Recurring: Scratch exercise, programme de calcul, probabilities, Pythagore/Thalès/trigonométrie, statistics/tableur, arithmetic. 'Toutes les réponses doivent être justifiées sauf indication contraire'; traces of research credited.
structure.calculator: Allowed throughout (mode examen or type collège, per paper cover pages, circulaire 2015-178).

structure.part: Two disciplines among PC / SVT / technologie
structure.description: Two disciplines announced ~2 months before the exam. 2018 série générale: SVT + technologie (S20 summary). 2024 série générale: PC + technologie (S21, press). Other years: press sources conflict (see limitations).

limitations: L1: education.gouv.fr HTML pages and eduscol.education.gouv.fr pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; several académie sites (ac-bordeaux ent2d, ac-orleans-tours, ac-nice, ac-guadeloupe) returned 503. Official texts were obtained through the BO PDF files on education.gouv.fr/sites/default/files (which were reachable). No restriction was bypassed.

L2: The Éduscol 'liste indicative d'automatismes' (S6) returned 404 at its redirect target; its exact content is not verified. The automatismes theme list in competency-map.md is inferred from labels in the official reference subjects (S4, S5) and the 2026 papers.

L3: Programme basis 2027: the task brief assumed 'from session 2027 the maths exam is based on the 3e programme'. The binding text for 2027 (S1, MENE2623228N) says '3e programme s'il est en vigueur ou, à défaut, programmes de cycle 4'. Since the new 3e maths programme (S11) applies only from rentrée 2028, the 2027 maths exam is effectively based on the current cycle 4 programme; the new programme would first be examined at session 2029 (3e in 2028-2029) — inference, not stated explicitly in any text read. The earlier wording (arrêté 10-4-2025 / S8: 'programmes de la classe de troisième à partir de 2027') and its amendment (arrêté 17-7-2026, NOR MENE2613731A) are known only via S13 and were not verified on Légifrance.

L4: The sujets de référence (S4, S5) carry no session date in the file; S15 presents them as 'brevet 2027'. They match the S1 format exactly, but the publication date is not officially confirmed here.

L5: Sciences 2027 reference subjects (technologie, SVT; PC unknown) were announced by académie de Bordeaux pages that returned 503; their contents are unverified. Choice of the two 2027 sciences disciplines is not yet known (to be announced ~2 months before 28 June 2027, i.e. around late April 2027).

L6: Historic sciences discipline choices per year conflict across press sources (2023 and 2025 notably); only 2018 (official summary), 2024 (L'Étudiant) and 2026 (digiSchool + Nomad agree) are recorded.
L7: Calculator use in the 2027 sciences épreuve is not stated in MENE2623228N; inferred from 2026 practice (S9).

L8: Theme frequencies in competency-map.md are the author's manual classification of 7 old-format métropole papers (2019, Sept 2020, 2021–2025) and 4 new-format 2026 papers + 2 zéro + 2 référence subjects, using APMEP transcriptions. Small sample; métropole only; not an official statistic.

L9: No official full corrigé is published openly for DNB maths; APMEP corrigés are independent volunteer work (not official, no open licence). Neither subjects nor corrigés may be copied into the product; cite by year/centre/exercise only.
